=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:_mt_merge_lease_tick function (within the loop over lease refs) | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `tick_q_gone` is initialized before the loop iterating over lease references but is not reset within the loop.
  WHY: If one lease base has skipped PRs, those PR numbers will accumulate in `tick_q_gone` and be erroneously excluded from the queue of subsequent lease bases processed in the same tick; currently harmless because PRs generally belong to a single base branch, but logically incorrect and could mislead queue logging (source severity NIT, mapped to low; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash raised the same issue only as HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS, not as findings).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Plan step 4.1 (D9) in docs/plans/merge-lease-parallel-merges-plan.md, lines 262-265: "Move the bodies of `_mt_git`, `_mt_git_fetch`, `_mt_probe_repo_init`, `_mt_probe_repo_cleanup` and `_mt_conflict_probe` (`scripts/review_merge_train.sh` 658-809) into `scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh` as `_pr_mt_git`, ... Keep the `_mt_*` functions as wrappers that call them and map the results to `_MT_PROBE_*`, including `ignored` via `MERGE_TRAIN_IGNORE_PATHS`." (plan line 86: "The `_mt_*` names stay as thin wrappers"); PR title claims phases 1-5 and the plan does not defer this step
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_merge_train.sh functions `_mt_git` (line 686), `_mt_git_fetch` (line 699), `_mt_probe_repo_init` (line 728), `_mt_probe_repo_cleanup`, `_mt_conflict_probe` (line 747) (still full implementations at lines 686-810)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The functions remain full standalone implementations at `scripts/review_merge_train.sh:686-810` and do not wrap the `_pr_*` helpers added in `scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2094-2220` (also cited as lines 2086-2258); a grep for `_pr_merge_tree_probe` in scripts/review_merge_train.sh finds nothing, neither the PR diff nor the last-run diff changes their bodies (train hunks touch only `_mt_list_open_prs`, the new `_mt_merge_lease_queue_log` / `_mt_merge_lease_queue_len` helpers, `_MT_LEASE_QUEUE_ROWS` / `_MT_LEASE_QUEUE_GONE` globals, and the `_mt_merge_lease_tick` / `_mt_merge_lease_tick_multi` bodies), the last run only reworded deferral comments (pr_checks_lib.sh:2067-2075 "Shared merge-tree conflict probe" header and agents.d/merge-lease-parallel-p4-soft-paths.md last bullet: "is still open ... change both copies together"), so two independent probe copies ship including the `GH_TOKEN` / `GITHUB_TOKEN` token-handling fetch path via `GIT_CONFIG_*` env vars that D9 rejects, new consumers (`_merge_lease_pr_paths`, `_pr_soft_merge_tree_probe`) bind to the library copy, and the deferral was made by the autofix editor, not the plan; the version-skew concern could be handled with a `declare -F _pr_merge_tree_probe` fallback guard already used for other library helpers
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: Plan step 4.1 (docs/plans/merge-lease-parallel-merges-plan.md, lines 262-265) asks to move the bodies of `_mt_git`, `_mt_git_fetch`, `_mt_probe_repo_init`, `_mt_probe_repo_cleanup` and `_mt_conflict_probe` into `scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh` as `_pr_*`, keeping the `_mt_*` functions as wrappers that map results to `_MT_PROBE_*`, including `ignored` via `MERGE_TRAIN_IGNORE_PATHS`. Line 86: "The `_mt_*` names stay as thin wrappers." The PR title claims plan phases 1-5.
  Expected change site: In scripts/review_merge_train.sh, the functions `_mt_git` (line 686), `_mt_git_fetch` (line 699), `_mt_probe_repo_init` (line 728), `_mt_probe_repo_cleanup` and `_mt_conflict_probe` (line 747).
  Evidence of absence: The functions are still full standalone implementations, and none calls `_pr_merge_tree_probe` (a grep in scripts/review_merge_train.sh finds nothing). Neither the PR diff nor the last-run diff changes their bodies. The last run changed only comments (the "Shared merge-tree conflict probe" header in scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh and agents.d/merge-lease-parallel-p4-soft-paths.md), which now say the conversion "is still open". Two independent probe copies ship, including the token-handling fetch path, which is the duplication D9 rejects. The plan does not defer this step; only the autofix editor did. The version-skew concern could be handled with a `declare -F _pr_merge_tree_probe` guard that falls back to the existing body.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- HARDENING_SUGGESTION scripts/review_merge_train.sh `_mt_merge_lease_tick`
  issue: `tick_q_gone` is declared once at the top of the function, appended in the skip-held unlabel loop (`tick_q_gone="${tick_q_gone},${tick_skip_pr}"`), and read by the no-waiter `_mt_merge_lease_queue_log ... "${tick_excluded}${tick_q_gone}"` call. It is never reset per lease ref, so one base's unlabelled PRs carry into later bases' `MERGE_LEASE_QUEUE` exclude list. Output is correct today only because `_mt_merge_lease_queue_log` filters by `.base`.
  fix: add `tick_q_gone=""` next to the other per-base resets before the candidate loop. Estimated lines changed: 1. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
